Deprecated name of grim_plot_grid()

Source: R/grim-plot-grid.R
grim_plot.Rd

grim_plot() was renamed to grim_plot_grid() in scrutiny 1.0.0. It keeps the signature it had in scrutiny 0.6.1, so that calls by position still work.

Usage

grim_plot(
  data = NULL,
  show_data = TRUE,
  show_raster = TRUE,
  show_gradient = TRUE,
  n = NULL,
  digits = NULL,
  rounding = "up_or_down",
  color_cons = deprecated(),
  color_incons = deprecated(),
  tile_alpha = deprecated(),
  tile_size = 1.5,
  raster_alpha = deprecated(),
  raster_color = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data, show_data, show_raster, show_gradient, n, rounding, tile_size

Passed on to grim_plot_grid().

digits, raster_color

The old names of grim_plot_grid()'s digits_x and color_raster.

color_cons, color_incons, tile_alpha, raster_alpha

No longer have any effect. To recolor the tiles, add a color scale, as in the examples of grim_plot_grid().

...

Other arguments of grim_plot_grid(), such as split_by_digits.
